Recover homing projectile lifecycles and live orbital launch geometry together (original checkpoints `87d0f24` and `69c4b55`).

spawn → direct home/target refs → Setup movement
Run → refresh collision avatar → retained-target steering or orbit/acquire
    → ordered shot/tank contact → separate twip position writes
live tank/status tree → Script width → enemy orbital launch radius
```

**Door:** two-way

Revertable simulation/rendering changes; no save migration or provider/billing changes.

**Blast Radius:** combat

Enemy seekers, both orbital variants, cached primary targeting and shared status bounds/contact. No original SWF, images/audio, dependency or build output committed.
